 HoopsHype Oct. 21, 2026, 3:37 a.m. ET Justin Martinez: Jalen Williams on where his game is at: “I think defensively, I’m great. That’s my bread and butter. That’s what I hang my hat on. Offensively, it’s having a new team and new lineups and new kind of everything. And that’s not just for me. A lot of our guys were in and out last year, so it’s just learning how to play with everybody, as weird as that sounds. I’m trying to still pick my spots and figure out what my spots even are because I basically didn’t play for a whole year and then I come back to a new team. But it’ll be a pretty quick adjustment. I have the ball a lot.”
